text:
Alex: quick heads up — reproducible TP step latency spike on staging with 8-way TP. When per-GPU all-reduce payloads hit ~48-96KB we see 2-3x step time. nvprof timeline + nccl traces attached.

Priya: can you paste the nccl-test numbers you ran? ring vs tree?

Alex: ran a small sweep, pasted below. note this is single-iter microbench on our staging net (4 nodes, PCIe+NVLink mix):
```
# nccl-tests all_reduce_perf snippet
./all_reduce_perf -b 1 -e 1M -f 2 -g 8
message_size(bytes)    avg_time(us)
32768                  48.2
49152                  92.3
65536                  137.6
98304                  260.1
```
The nvprof shows repeated small kernels waiting on NCCL allreduce completion spikes. Root suspicion: our kernel selection is coalescing KV-cache updates into the same collective which inflates message sizes, and the batcher heuristics occasionally flush multiple sequences together.

Miguel: ok that matches something we saw on baremetal — ring is efficient for very large >256KB but mid-range 32-128KB can be worse than tree. What NCCL/CUDA versions?

Alex: NCCL 2.12.10, CUDA 11.8. Also nvlink lane utilization looks uneven — some ranks get all the traffic.

Sam: quick mitigation options: set NCCL_ALGO=tree or NCCL_PROTO=LL for mid-sized messages; also lower the TP batch flush threshold so per-GPU msgsize stays <32KB. We should also try NCCL_COLLNET for cross-node.

Priya: I can run a full msgsize sweep (1KB -> 1MB) with nccl-tests per-rank bandwidth/times tonight and capture nvprof. Will log results to the ticket.

Miguel: I'll spin a staging run with NCCL_ALGO=tree and compare tail latencies. Also test with enabling NCCL_TOPO_AWARE=1 to see if routing helps.

Alex: action items:
- Priya: run sweep + nvprof and drop logs in the perf ticket (assigned to you)
- Miguel: try tree-only staging build and collect tail latency comparison
- Sam: PR to add an ephemeral TP batch cap override (config flag) and a telemetry metric for per-allreduce msgsize distribution
- I'll add the kernel traces and the KV-cache aggregation hotspot to the ticket.

infra-bot: created perf ticket INC-2026, linked the traces and assigned to Priya/Miguel/Sam

Priya: noted. I'll start at 21:00 PT.

Alex: thanks team :thumbsup:
